_comment: CR-T8: every Monitor line that states an estimate or prediction is declared here. reveals = value ids the line states or implies (hidden while a forecast about one is open for that player). hidden_under = guidance levels that never see the line. mars:solar_power is the value id forecast F1 (storm and solar power) will open; the storm cause line and the panel pointer are held back while it is open (CR-F9, CR-T8; ui-specs.md section 10). A test fails if a monitor.goal.eta* or monitor.estimate.* key in en_us.json is missing here.
